subject: Quick apology about the parking charge
text:
Hi there,

Sorry for the mix-up with the shoot logistics. I assumed the location permit would cover after-hours access, but the venue ended up charging a separate security fee. That came as a surprise, and I did not mean to leave you sorting out the invoice alone. I can absorb the difference this time, and I will double-check all incidental costs before the next booking. Let me know if the reimbursement note needs a revised amount.

Appreciate your patience.
